definitions.explanation: A small pouch or wallet specifically for carrying coins. Separate from a regular wallet in Japanese culture, where coins are commonly used for daily transactions.

examples.japanese: {小銭入|こぜにい}れを{忘|わす}れた。
{革|かわ}の{小銭入|こぜにい}れをプレゼントにもらった。
examples.english: I received a leather coin purse as a gift.

examples.japanese: {小銭入|こぜにい}れが{重|おも}くなってきたので、コンビニで{使|つか}おう。
examples.english: My coin purse has gotten heavy, so I'll use the coins at the convenience store.

notes:
Composed of {小銭|こぜに} (small change, coins) + {入|い}れ (container, holder). In Japan, many people carry a separate coin purse in addition to their {財布|さいふ} (wallet), since coins up to 500 yen are commonly used in everyday transactions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {革|かわ}の{小銭入|こぜにい}れ: leather coin purse
- がま{口|ぐち}の{小銭入|こぜにい}れ: snap-clasp coin purse
- {小銭入|こぜにい}れに{入|い}れる: to put in a coin purse

RELATED TERMS:
- {財布|さいふ}: wallet — the general-purpose wallet, may also hold coins
- {札入|さつい}れ: billfold — a wallet specifically for bills
- {小銭|こぜに}: small change, coins
